task_metadata.research_topic: protein sequence encoder design for function prediction
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel protein sequence encoder architecture that learns effective representations for predicting protein function from amino acid sequences.
notes: The task evaluates sequence encoders on beta-lactamase, fluorescence, and solubility regression benchmarks.
Baseline links are approximate architecture matches for the shared DeepProtein scaffold.

tests.label: Beta
tests.notes: Closest concrete citation is ECNet, which reports TEM-1 beta-lactamase engineering results.

tests.label: Fluorescence
tests.notes: Mapped to the TAPE fluorescence regression benchmark.

tests.label: Solubility
tests.notes: Mapped to sequence-based protein solubility prediction literature, especially GraphSol.

baselines.name: cnn
baselines.notes: Sequence-only CNN baseline; ProteInfer is the closest concrete protein-function CNN reference.

baselines.name: transformer
baselines.notes: Standard Transformer encoder baseline; ProtTrans is the closest concrete protein transfer-learning reference.

baselines.name: dgl_gcn
baselines.notes: Residue-graph GCN baseline; GraphSol is the closest concrete solubility-focused reference.
